title: Methods for treating intestinal inflammation by modulating IL23R signaling
abstract: Disclosed are compositions and methods related to IL23R signaling in intestinal inflammation. The disclosure claims therapeutic, diagnostic and biomarker uses. This is a synthetic patent record for a teaching demo.
claims: 1. A method of treating inflammatory bowel disease in a subject, comprising administering a therapeutically effective amount of a IL23R modulator.
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the IL23R modulator is an antibody or antigen-binding fragment.
3. The method of claim 1, wherein the subject has ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease.
4. A biomarker panel comprising at least one IL23R expression marker.
embodiments: Example 1: In vitro assay. Primary human CD4+ T cells were stimulated with IL-23 and treated with a IL23R modulator. Cytokine secretion was measured by ELISA. The example is synthetic and illustrative only.
Example 2: Animal model. A chronic colitis model was used to assess clinical score and histology. No numerical data are provided in this synthetic record.
